observations.code_quote: - **Metrics telemetry**: each asset also captures its metrics as events into the dogfood project (the same project the label events land in), through `training/telemetry.py`: `inbox_ranking_examples_built` and `inbox_ranking_candidate_trained` once per head (`head`, holdout / train AUC, average precision, logloss, positive rate, the permutation-null mean and spread, counts, `readable`) and `inbox_ranking_promotion_decided` once per run, all carrying `model_version` and stamped midday UTC on the partition day so re-runs and backfills chart on the day they describe. Per-head stability is a trends insight with a `head` breakdown; a readability drop is an insight alert. `metadata.json` stays the durable record. Capture is best-effort. Local dev runs (`DEBUG`) emit too, under `distinct_id` `inbox_ranking_training_local` with `environment=local`, so filter or break down on `environment` when reading the prod series; any other non-Cloud deployment emits nothing.
